name: Insufficient Session Expiration
title: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in LLM application platforms and chat interfaces, as the CVEs here all sit in Langflow and Open WebUI. The usual way it is reached is through credentials that stay valid after the account or role behind them changes, so a deactivated user, a demoted admin or a revoked token still carries authority. What it lets an attacker do is keep using that old access, reading notes, reaching realtime channels or holding API keys that should already be dead. CVE-2026-81268 in Langflow and CVE-2026-87014 and CVE-2026-59219 in Open WebUI are the examples.
description: According to WASC, Insufficient Session Expiration is when a web site permits an attacker to reuse old session credentials or session IDs for authorization.
